technology_name: Decision Support System for Technology Valuation
institution: KSCSTE- Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM)
problem_solved: The complexity, ambiguity, and lack of standardized frameworks for accurately calculating the financial value of newly developed scientific technologies and IP for commercialization.
description: A sophisticated Decision Support System (DSS) algorithm designed to value intellectual assets and patents developed in public research institutions. The software synthesizes variables like development costs, market conditions, and future cash flows to compute a fair commercial value. It features a custom matrix for fixing royalty ranges and automatically fetches default macroeconomic data (depreciation, bank rates) if specific inputs are missing, outputting a comprehensive PDF valuation report.
applications:
• Technology Transfer Offices (TTOs) negotiating licensing deals with startups

• Corporate R&D strategic planning and technology pricing

• Financial securitization, IP taxation, and venture capital auditing

• Legal settlements for patent infringement lawsuits
